remarks: PLEASE PRESENT ALL OFFERS BY TUESDAY THE 4TH BY 12pm. This beautifully maintained 4 bed/3 bath tri-level townhouse offers a rare blend of comfort and convenience. Located in a highly desirable neighborhood on a quiet cul-de-sac - just minutes from Downtown Stamford, the Train Station, I-95, & Mill River Park. Currently rented for $3,720/month (7% cap rate), this townhouse boasts a solid 12+ year track record of consistent rental income. Upon entry, you're welcomed by a bright & airy living room, flooded with natural light that flows seamlessly into the kitchen. The breakfast bar provides a contemporary touch, perfect for entertaining & casual dining. The spacious eat-in kitchen is equipped with modern stainless-steel appliances, elegant granite countertops, & rich wood cabinetry. The kitchen opens to a spacious deck, ideal for relaxation & sunsets. 2 assigned parking spaces are located adjacent to the deck, with additional on-street parking available. On the 2nd floor, you'll find 2 well-sized bedrooms with ample closet space, as well as a full bath featuring a shower, tub, & laundry area. Located on the 3rd floor, the master suite provides a tranquil escape, complete with a skylight & full ensuite bath for added privacy & convenience. The finished basement is versatile, featuring a full bath & offering numerous possibilities for use as a 4th bedroom, family room, office, or gym. With low monthly HOA fees & a proven rental history.
